Start a Round

Three modes.
One tap to tee off.

Hit Start Round on any course page and choose what you want to track. Run one mode or combine them — Caddie Mode pairs with Caddy Cash or Solo Round so you can track conditions and scores simultaneously, toggling between them mid-round.

Select your mode at tee off
📋 Caddie Mode

Be the Caddie

Journal the course as you play. Tag conditions hole by hole — greens, pace, course status, real-time moments — and post the most detailed report on the platform when you finish.

1
Select Caddie Mode at Start Round
2
Tap condition tiles as you play each hole
3
Finish Round — your report posts live to the course page

💡 Pair with Caddy Cash or Solo Round and toggle between modes mid-round without losing your data.

💰 Caddy Cash

Put Cash on It

Select from 9 preset betting games, add opponents from your roster, set your stakes, and let the app track every dollar. Nassau, Wolf, Junk, Vegas — run multiple games at the same time.

1
Select Caddy Cash, add opponents from your roster
2
Toggle on your games and set dollar amounts per point
3
Score hole by hole — standings update in real time

💡 Win/loss record and running totals tracked against every opponent forever.

🏌️ Solo Round

Track Your Round

No bets, no opponents — just your scorecard. Track your individual round, save it to your profile history, and build your personal stat record across every course you play.

1
Select Solo Round at Start Round
2
Enter your score hole by hole — par and handicap shown
3
Finish — round saves to My Rounds in your profile

💡 Clean, honest round tracking. No betting required. Saved to your profile forever.

Caddy Cash

Pick any combination of games for a single round — multiple games run simultaneously. Set your stakes, add your opponents from your saved roster, and let TheCaddyReport settle the score.

Solo Round & My Rounds

Your personal
golf history.

Every round you track saves to your profile automatically. Solo Round is pure scorecard tracking — no betting, no pressure. Just your game, recorded forever.
